name: software-factory-cli
description: Multi-agent software factory — installer, local daemon, and control panel as a single CLI.

scripts.build: npm run build:factory && npm run build:panel
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 src/__tests__/*.test.ts && npm run test:fast
scripts.test:fast: node --import tsx --test test/signal-forward.test.mjs test/pipeline-outcome.test.mjs test/panel-state.test.mjs test/daemon-support.test.mjs test/factory-config.test.mjs test/pipeline-definition.test.mjs test/panel-read-model.test.mjs test/worker-executor.test.mjs test/lease-manager.test.mjs test/lease-wait-state.test.mjs test/operation-receipts.test.mjs test/workflow-boundaries.test.mjs test/daemon-issue-list-parse.test.mjs test/daemon-checkpoint-null.test.mjs test/worker-pool.test.mjs test/implementation-worktree-clean.test.mjs test/agent-backends-environment.test.mjs && node --test test/implementation-contract.test.mjs
